tldr: Mars in Sagittarius: action is adventurous, candid, and motivated by belief.
body: With Mars in Sagittarius, drive moves toward exploration, truth, risk, and the next horizon. You act when something feels meaningful enough to chase.
gift: Courage, enthusiasm, moral fire, and willingness to take a leap.
challenge: Recklessness, bluntness, and acting from belief before checking the facts.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
